decisions.reason: Reviewed the original overlapping viewport PNGs at the native logical width, including every supplied note paragraph in order. Queue/inspector/action/notes hierarchy, label and inspection-note wrapping, selected border/marker, and spacing are readable with no overlapping or component-clipped content. Content outside one scroll viewport is not clipping. FAIL: disabled Submit review visibly applies an additional fade to the specified border-fill and muted-text palette roles. The faded label is visibly lighter in light mode / darker in dark mode than the nearby body muted role; original design BRIEF requires border fill and muted text, and P1 reference shows the unfaded disabled primary. Source sets those roles then uses PlainButtonStyle plus .disabled; actual native output does not preserve them. This is visual appearance, not a computed native iOS color measurement.
